name: BDMediLeaves
description: This dataset focused on six medicinal plants ( Phyllanthus Emblica, Terminalia Arjuna, Kalanchoe Pinnata, Centella Asiatica, Justicia Adhatoda and Mikania Micrantha ) based in Bangladesh. All the leaves images were taken separately by iPhone 13. The purpose of  image augmentation was to expand the dataset's size and mitigate the risk of overfitting during the training and validation of the model. "BDMediLeaves" dataset have two subfolders one is  non-augmented another one is augmented. In non-augmented folder there are six different sub folders which are named by six different medicinal plant species and these subfolders have also three subfolders “train”, “test”, “validation”.
